categories.description: An advertisement, product announcement, or other marketing email
An email asking me to leave a review or provide feedback on a product or service
A news report or article
A notice with news or information from the government of the town or city I live in
A notice or report from a community watch group or service about local activity, such as planned events, traffic, or crime
A health-related notice or alert issued by a hospital, medical institute, or government agency
A notice about a product recall
Email from a classified service (such as Craigslist) containing information about my account or an advertisement I posted
A personal email between me and another individual, not an email from a company or agency
An email that I sent to myself (including emails I send from my personal email to my work emails)
A notice that someone mentioned me in a chat channel
An email showing activity from a specific person on a social media website
An "friend request"-type invitation from a specific person on a social media website
A notice that a phone, video, or VoIP call was missed
A notice that a message or voicemail from a phone number was left
A confirmation that I have a placed an order, eg. at an e-commerce store
A notice confirming that a refund was requested, approved, or received
A notice that a refund was issued or processed
A notice that a package has shipped or delivery has been scheduled
A notice that there has been a delay or other change to an in-flight delivery
A notice that a package or shipment was delivered or dropped off
A notice that a package or shipment order was canceled
A daily "Informed Delivery" email from USPS
A utility bill, eg., internet, phone, electricity, gas, etc
An email containing a statement or transaction history from a financial institution
A notice from a bank or financial institution that isn't a routine statement or transaction
An email from a financial instution about my credit or credit report
A confirmation that I signed up for or cancelled a subscription
An email containing a magic sign-in link
A notice that I've received a new secure message (typically by a banking institution)
A notice that I have unread messages
An email containing a time-based one-time password
An email indicating that my account logged in from a new device
An email indicating that my data was found in a data leak or breach
A notice from a company or agency about a change to one of their policies
A notice from a company or agency about a change to my own information
An email related to a job that I've applied to
An email related to an interview for a job that I've applied to
An email containing an offer for a job that I've interviewed for
A reminder or confirmation about an upcoming appointment
An acknowledgement that a ticket was opened, or someone responded to that ticket
An email about a Github action or other CI/CD process that succeeded
An email about a Github action or other CI/CD process that failed or raised a warning or error
An email containing a daily data backup
